'''RL-4''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] as a special envoy in [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]. In [[3639 BBY]] RL-4 was visiting the [[Carrick Station]], where he contacted an important figure, specifically selected by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], to join [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hardin (captain)|Hardin]] of the [[Outrider (Thranta-class corvette)|''Outrider'']] on a mission to the [[Vyron system/Legends|Vyron system]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
RL-4 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Operation courier for the "Karagga's Palace" operation. Originally present on the Carrick Station, he was moved to [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] with Update 4.0.<ref name="SWTOR" />
